ILLNESS\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 15 days ago when he developed high grade fever which was associated with associated with food intake, belching and regurgitation but a\/w shortness of breath.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe developed Anasarca.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EB\/l pedal edema
